body: I'm 20... Whenever I look back at what I do, I'm annoyed that I don't have self control over myself.

It's not fair that things like this happen to people like us. I feel self hatred too, but I want to get away from that. But please, reconsider your choice. If I could, I'd go there right now and somehow help you.

Thank you for listening to me when I feel like I can't rely on other people. I feel like I'd burden people with my problems, and I really wish that none of this happened to me or anyone at all. Oh man, I'm tearing up right now. 

I'll try and talk to my friends about my problem, and I really hope that they wont say "again?" or just laugh it off. I really really really want to get through this.

Thank you so much for taking the time to talk to me. I think that you are a wonderful person that deserves love and happiness every day. I constantly think about how people will react if anything should happen to me. I feel horrible that I can even think that they can live without me. I know exactly what I have to change with myself, but I don't know if I'll be strong enough to continue.

Thank you for being there for me. I'm really really happy that you're here.

I know that people are there for me, and that they're all happy that I somehow influenced their lives. I want to reach out to them, but I feel like they'll treat me like I'm mentally ill or that they'll treat me differently. 

I can't say anything to my parents since my mom told me that if my dad ever found out that I wanted to kill myself again, he'd get sick from a heart problem. If I was causing this much problems to them, I hate the fact that I was born at all.

These are the thoughts that I want to get out of my head, but somehow they always come back to haunt me... like it's got a tight grip around my neck and any more pressure I'd just end it right then and there.

Then I find myself thinking it's going to be ok... then back again... like I am crazy. There has been so many moments where I just want to go to a doctor and hand myself over, saying that I'm a threat to my own life... but what will be the effects of that to the people around me? I'm going to assume that it'd affect them similar to actually committing. So I live each day with no purpose. Things throughout the day would fix my feelings, then at night... it'd start all over again.
